comment: Third-party Windows x64 runtimes bundled in the offline installer. Every archive is pinned by SHA-256; scripts/fetch-binaries.mjs refuses anything that does not match. Update deliberately: change url+version, then re-pin the hash from a trusted download.

vcRuntime.comment: PostgreSQL and Poppler link the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 runtime, which a clean Windows install may lack. The official redistributable DLLs (VC\Redist\MSVC\<ver>\x64\Microsoft.VC143.CRT) are deployed app-locally next to those binaries, as permitted by the Visual Studio redistribution terms. node.exe links the CRT statically, but native addons (argon2) import vcruntime140.dll, so it is also placed next to node.exe (the process's application directory is searched first).
